description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to generating and decrypting organization IDs using AES encryption in ECB mode with a specific salt. It includes functions to convert hexadecimal salts to CryptoJS WordArray, generate encrypted organization IDs from emails, and decrypt them for debugging. Also, it contains a validation check for the tenant salt.

methods.name: hexToWordArray(hex)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray suitable for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId(email)
methods.description: Generates a URL-encoded organization ID by encrypting a normalized email with a tenant salt using AES-128-ECB encryption.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId(encUrlEncoded)
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted organization ID (URL-encoded) back to the original normalized email for debugging purposes.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid()
methods.description: Checks whether the tenant salt is set and considered valid (non-empty).
